an4.173:1.1: Atha kho āyasmā Mahākoṭṭhito yen' āyasmā Sāriputto ten' upasaṅkami, upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā Sāriputtena saddhiṃ sammodi . . .
an4.173:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā Mahākoṭṭhito āyasmantaṃ Sāriputtaṃ etad avoca :
an4.173:2.1: Channaṃ āvuso phassāyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā atth' aññaṃ kiñcīti?
an4.173:4.1: Channaṃ āvuso phassāyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā n' atth' aññaṃ kiñcīti?
an4.173:6.1: Channaṃ āvuso phassāyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā atthi ca n' atthi c' aññaṃ kiñcīti?
an4.173:8.1: Channaṃ āvuso phassāyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā n' ev' atthi no atth' aññaṃ kiñcīti.
an4.173:10.5: mā h' evaṃ āvuso ti vadesi.
an4.173:10.6: Channaṃ āvuso phassāyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā n' atth' aññaṃ kiñcīti iti puṭṭho samāno
an4.173:10.7: mā h' evaṃ avūso ti vadesi.
an4.173:10.8: Channaṃ . . . -nirodhā atthi ca n' atthi c' aññaṃ kiñcīti iti puṭṭho samāno mā h' evaṃ āvuso ti vadesi. Channaṃ . . . -nirodhā n' ev' atth' no n' atth' aññaṃ kiñcīti iti puṭṭho samāno mā h' evaṃ āvuso ti vadesi. Yathākathaṃ pan' āvuso imassa bhāsitassa attho daṭṭhabbo ti? 3.
an4.173:11.1: Channaṃ āvuso . . . -nirodhā atth' aññaṃ kiñcīti iti vadaṃ appapañcaṃ papañceti,
an4.173:11.2: channaṃ āvuso . . . -nirodhā n' atth' aññaṃ kiñcīti iti vadaṃ appapañcaṃ papañceti,
an4.173:11.3: channaṃ . . . -nirodhā atthi ca n' atthi c' aññaṃ kiñcīti iti vadaṃ appapañcaṃ papañceti,
an4.173:11.4: channaṃ . . . -nirodhā n' ev' atthi no n' atth' aññaṃ kiñcīti iti vadaṃ appapañcaṃ papañceti.
an4.173:11.5: Yāvatā āvuso channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ gati tāvatā papañcassa gati,
an4.173:11.6: yāvatā papañcassa gati tāvatā channaṃ phassāyatanānaṃ gati.
an4.173:11.7: Channaṃ āvuso phassāyatanānaṃ asesavirāganirodhā papañcanirodho papañcavūpasamo
